newsitem.title: UK: Sheffield Utd confirms Kendall's departure.
newsitem.headline: Sheffield Utd confirms Kendall's departure.

text.p: English first division football club Sheffield United Plc confirmed on Friday that Howard Kendall was leaving his post as manager to head Everton football club.
Sheffield said Everton had agreed to compensate it for releasing Kendall from his contract.
The amount of compensation was under discussion.
Sheffield said it would begin searching for a new manager immediately, while assistant manager Nigel Spackman would take over as caretaker manager.
Kendall, who took Sheffield United into the first division play-off final last season, joined the club as manager about 18 months ago.
